Primary methodological record for RNA-seq analysis design, quality control, and best practices.

# Scope for simitall

This primary-method record grounds agent guidance about RNA-seq analysis design, quality control, and best practices. It should be used to identify appropriate inputs, outputs, QC, and assumptions; it does not by itself validate a biological scenario.

# Agent-Safe Takeaways

- Use this source when a request involves rnaseq and best practices, differential expression.
- Keep the exact software version, parameterization, input coordinate system, and random seed in workflow provenance where applicable.
- Prefer benchmark designs with explicit truth or held-out validation rather than relying on a single summary metric.

# Inputs to Specify

- A clearly defined biological or technical scenario
- Versioned input data and coordinate/reference metadata
- Method-specific parameter choices and validation design

# Expected Outputs

- Method results and reproducible configuration
- Quality-control summaries
- Truth, benchmark, or held-out validation metrics when available

# Limitations and Guardrails
